mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag t ON h.tag_id = t.tag_id
AND t.tag_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT folder_id, folder_name, parent_id, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_alarm_folder ORDER BY folder_name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO tb_alarm_folder (folder_name, parent_id, sort_order) VALUES (#{folderName}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT tag_id, folder_id, tag_name, address, plc_id, alarm_msg, level, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_alarm_tag WHERE folder_id = #{value} ORDER BY tag_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_alarm_tag (folder_id, tag_name, address, plc_id, alarm_msg, level, enabled) VALUES (#{folderId}, #{tagName}, #{address}, #{plcId}, #{alarmMsg}, #{level}, #{enabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE address = VALUES(address), plc_id = VALUES(plc_id), alarm_msg = VALUES(alarm_msg), level = VALUES(level), enabled = VALUES(enabled)
mapper.select: SELECT plc_id, ip, port, plc_type, label, enabled FROM tb_plc ORDER BY plc_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_plc (plc_id, ip, port, plc_type, label, enabled) VALUES (#{plcId}, #{ip}, #{port}, #{plcType}, #{label}, #{enabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ip = VALUES(ip), port = VALUES(port), plc_type = VALUES(plc_type), label = VALUES(label), enabled = VALUES(enabled)
mapper.select: SELECT h.history_id, h.tag_id, t.tag_name, t.address, t.alarm_msg, t.level, t.plc_id, t.folder_id, f.folder_name, h.occur_time, h.clear_time, h.ack_time, h.ack_user, h.value_at_occur FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag t ON h.tag_id = t.tag_id JOIN tb_alarm_folder f ON t.folder_id = f.folder_id WHERE h.clear_time IS NULL ORDER BY h.occur_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT h.history_id, h.tag_id, t.tag_name, t.address, t.alarm_msg, t.level, t.plc_id, t.folder_id, f.folder_name, h.occur_time, h.clear_time, h.ack_time, h.ack_user, h.value_at_occur FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag t ON h.tag_id = t.tag_id JOIN tb_alarm_folder f ON t.folder_id = f.folder_id ORDER BY h.occur_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT h.history_id, h.tag_id, t.tag_name, t.address, t.alarm_msg, t.level, t.plc_id, t.folder_id, f.folder_name, h.occur_time, h.clear_time, h.ack_time, h.ack_user, h.value_at_occur FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag t ON h.tag_id = t.tag_id JOIN tb_alarm_folder f ON t.folder_id = f.folder_id WHERE h.occur_time >= #{from} AND h.occur_time <= #{to} ORDER BY h.occur_time DESC

SELECT t.tag_name AS groupKey, t.tag_name AS label, COUNT(*) AS count, MAX(h.occur_time) AS lastOccurTime FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag t ON h.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE h.occur_time >= #{from} AND h.occur_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT t.plc_id AS groupKey, COALESCE(p.label, t.plc_id) AS label, COUNT(*) AS count, MAX(h.occur_time) AS lastOccurTime FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag t ON h.tag_id = t.tag_id LEFT JOIN tb_plc p ON t.plc_id = p.plc_id WHERE h.occur_time >= #{from} AND h.occur_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY t.plc_id, p.label ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT t.folder_id AS groupKey, f.folder_name AS label, COUNT(*) AS count, MAX(h.occur_time) AS lastOccurTime FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag t ON h.tag_id = t.tag_id JOIN tb_alarm_folder f ON t.folder_id = f.folder_id WHERE h.occur_time >= #{from} AND h.occur_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY t.folder_id, f.folder_name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT t.folder_id AS folderId, f.folder_name AS folderLabel, t.alarm_msg AS alarmMsg, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(h.occur_time) AS lastOccurTime FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag t ON h.tag_id = t.tag_id JOIN tb_alarm_folder f ON t.folder_id = f.folder_id WHERE h.occur_time >= #{from} AND h.occur_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY t.folder_id, f.folder_name, t.alarm_msg ORDER BY t.folder_id ASC, cnt DESC

SELECT t.folder_id AS folderId, f.folder_name AS folderLabel,
DATE_FORMAT(h.occur_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') DATE_FORMAT(h.occur_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag t ON h.tag_id = t.tag_id JOIN tb_alarm_folder f ON t.folder_id = f.folder_id WHERE h.occur_time >= #{from} AND h.occur_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY t.folder_id, f.folder_name, bucket ORDER BY bucket ASC, t.folder_id ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.occur_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS bucket, t.level AS level, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag t ON h.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE h.occur_time >= #{from} AND h.occur_time < #{to} GROUP BY bucket, t.level ORDER BY bucket ASC

SELECT t.folder_id AS folderId, f.folder_name AS folderLabel, t.level AS level, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag t ON h.tag_id = t.tag_id JOIN tb_alarm_folder f ON t.folder_id = f.folder_id WHERE h.occur_time >= #{from} AND h.occur_time < #{to} GROUP BY t.folder_id, f.folder_name, t.level ORDER BY t.folder_id ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.occur_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS bucket, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, h.occur_time, h.clear_time)) AS avgMinutes, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_alarm_history h WHERE h.clear_time IS NOT NULL AND h.occur_time >= #{from} AND h.occur_time < #{to} GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket ASC
